# ex: implicit wildcard function (check run + assigneeType path)
ex {
	var f func(int) int
	var x int
	implicit f
	f(x) -> x + 1
}
-- x.go --
package m

func F() int {
	var x int = 1
	return x
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 package m

 func F() int {
-	var x int = 1
-	return x
+	var x int = 1 + 1
+	return x + 1
 }
